sermon.title: What Jesus Did Not Say— November 21, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus never said come to a temple, building, religion or leader; He said come to the light so our deeds are exposed, and come to Me and learn from Me. He invites us to be made by Him and to be with Him.

faqs.question: What did Jesus not say?
faqs.answer: Come to a temple, house or religion.

faqs.question: What did Jesus say instead?
faqs.answer: Come to the light, and come to Me.

faqs.question: Why come to the light?
faqs.answer: So our deeds may be exposed as done in God.

faqs.question: What is the condemnation in John 3?
faqs.answer: Hating the light and not coming to it.

faqs.question: Can believers be condemned?
faqs.answer: The Pharisees were believers who would not come to the light.

faqs.question: What can pastors do for you?
Why fast?
faqs.answer: Some strongholds come out only by prayer and fasting.

faqs.question: What does “ordained” mean here?
faqs.answer: He made, constructed and fashioned them.

faqs.question: Can I come to Jesus for someone else?
faqs.answer: Yes, like the nobleman for his son.
